FIFO队列操作与单服务器调度模型

objectives.title: 解释FIFO队列特性与基本操作
objectives.description: 解释FIFO队列按先进先出顺序存储项目，enqueue在队尾添加，dequeue移除并返回队首，peek返回队首不移除，插入顺序（非字母序）决定下次dequeue，队列内容从首到尾用方括号书写。
objectives.priorityRationale: 材料锚定FIFO基本操作话题，但所选精确证据E11、E35的权威包为unavailable，无法支持required正式评估，作为核心教学义务保持高优先级非认证教学。

objectives.title: 追踪完整操作序列并区分返回值与剩余状态
objectives.description: 从给定初始队列出发追踪完整操作序列，对每次enqueue/dequeue/peek说明返回值与剩余内容，区分返回值与剩余状态；对空队列执行dequeue或peek时报告empty且队列不变，不虚构项目或复用已移除项目；所有序列明确初始队列与操作无隐藏状态。
objectives.priorityRationale: 所选精确证据E4、E28、E34、E20、E26自身权威包为formal_sufficient且支持apply，覆盖追踪序列与空队列安全约定，符合独立授权的正式评估路径，故required。
objectives.formalAssessmentReadinessRationale: 当前版本存在已验证且无冲突的精确来源权威。

objectives.title: 在单服务器FIFO假设下计算服务时间线并说明不重排
objectives.description: 在显式单服务器FIFO假设下（一次服务一个任务、运行至完成不中断、空闲且有等待任务立即开始、到达加队尾、服务中不在等待队列、同时到达按输入序、时间单位相同），计算各任务开始时间=max(到达时间,上一任务完成时间)，完成时间=开始+服务时长，等待时间=开始-到达，系统内总时间=完成-到达，并分别说明；展示FIFO不因任务更短而提前于更早到达者。
objectives.priorityRationale: 所选精确证据E18、E15、E1、E30、E36自身权威包为formal_sufficient且支持apply，覆盖单服务器时间线计算与不重排规则，故required。
objectives.formalAssessmentReadinessRationale: 当前版本存在已验证且无冲突的精确来源权威。

regions.rationale: 该精确来源区域被纳入课程骨架并进入详细生成。

[{"slotId":"L1","lessonNarrative":{"whyNow":"给定若干任务的到达时间与服务时长，如何在不逐步模拟队列的情况下算出每个任务的开始与完成时间，并证明更短的任务不会插队？","summary":"单服务器FIFO下，开始时间=max(到达,上一完成)，完成=开始+服务，等待=开始-到达；服务顺序由到达时刻与同时到达的输入序固定，短任务不提前。","forwardBridge":null},"explanation":"先建立单服务器FIFO的量化模型：任务一次一个、运行至完成、到达加队尾、同时到达按输入序。设任务A到达0服务2，B到达1服务3，C到达3服务1。按规则，A开始=max(0,0)=0，完成2；B开始=max(1,2)=2，完成5；C开始=max(3,5)=5，完成6。可见C虽比B短，仍须等B完成才开始，说明FIFO不按服务时长重排。等待时间分别为0、1、2，系统内总时间为完成减到达。","sourceRefs":[],"visualRefs":[],"semanticRelations":[],"workedProcess":null},{"slotId":"L2","explanation":"通过一个含同时到达的案例演练计算步骤。规则同前：开始=max(到达,上一完成)，完成=开始+服务。下面给出具体任务与已算出的首步，其余由学习者推演。","sourceRefs":[],"visualRefs":[],"semanticRelations":[],"workedProcess":{"startingState":"空队列，单服务器FIFO：一次一个、运行至完成、同时到达按输入序M然后N。M到达2服务4，N到达2服务2，O到达5服务1。","inputs":["M到达2服务4","N到达2服务2","O到达5服务1"],"ruleOrProcedure":"开始时间=max(到达时间,上一任务完成时间)；完成时间=开始+服务时长；等待时间=开始-到达。","steps":[{"action":"计算M开始与完成","reason":"M最早到达2且服务器空闲，开始=max(2,0)=2，完成=2+4=6","resultingState":"M开始2完成6；N已在队列等待；O尚未到达"},{"action":"计算N开始与完成及O开始","reason":"N到达2，上一完成6，开始=max(2,6)=6，完成=6+2=8；O到达5，上一完成8，开始=max(5,8)=8，完成=8+1=9","resultingState":"N开始6完成8；O开始8完成9，等待3"}],"learnerDecision":"推导O的开始时间与等待时间","result":"O开始8完成9等待3","whyResultFollows":"O到达5晚于M完成6但早于N完成8，故在N完成后开始，开始=8，等待=8-5=3。","sourceRefs":[],"interaction":{"pauseAfterStepIndex":0,"sourceRefs":[],"activity":{"reasoningOperation":"predict_outcome","requiredInference":"由M完成6、N接续至8，推得O开始为8。","decisiveCondition":"O到达5且上一完成8，故开始=max(5,8)=8。","evidenceContrast":{"evidence":"M开始2完成6","replacement":"M开始2完成7","alternativeOptionId":"B"},"prompt":"基于上述M的计算与规则，O的开始时间是？","options":[{"id":"A","text":"8","feedbackIfSelected":"正确：O开始于N完成之后，即8。","misconception":null},{"id":"B","text":"5","feedbackIfSelected":"误把O到达时间当作开始，忽略服务器正忙。","misconception":{"hypothesis":"到达即可开始","whyTempting":"只看到达时刻而忘记FIFO必须等前驱完成","correction":"开始=max(到达,上一完成)，上一完成为8"}},{"id":"C","text":"6","feedbackIfSelected":"误把M完成时间当作O开始，忽略N介于其间。","misconception":{"hypothesis":"O在M完成后立即开始","whyTempting":"漏掉N同在前序队列中","correction":"N在M后服务至8，O只能之后开始"}}],"correctOptionId":"A","correctDebrief":"前一任务链完成于8，O到达5不早于该时刻，故开始=8。"},"hint":"先看M完成后谁在队列：N到达2且未服务，故N先。","scaffold":{"reasoningOperation":"predict_outcome","requiredInference":"由M完成6且N排队，推得N开始6。","decisiveCondition":"N到达2，上一完成6，开始=max(2,6)=6。","prompt":"N的开始时间是多少？","options":[{"id":"A","text":"6","feedbackIfSelected":"正确：N开始于M完成6。"},{"id":"B","text":"2","feedbackIfSelected":"误把到达时间当开始，忽略M占用服务器。"}],"correctOptionId":"A","debrief":"N虽与M同时到达，但输入序在后，须等M完成。"},"transfer":{"reasoningOperation":"predict_outcome","requiredInference":"应用新排序规则重算前驱完成时间，得O开始8。","evidenceContrast":{"evidence":"同时到达任务按服务时长升序排列（最短优先），其余FIFO；案例改为M服务5、N服务1同时到达2输入序M然后N，O到达5服务1。","replacement":"同时到达任务按输入序排列（原FIFO），案例同M服务5、N服务1同时到达2输入序M然后N，O到达5服务1。","alternativeOptionId":"A"},"changedCondition":"同时到达任务按服务时长升序排列（最短优先），其余FIFO；案例改为M服务5、N服务1同时到达2输入序M然后N，O到达5服务1。","prompt":"在新规下，O的开始时间是多少？","options":[{"id":"A","text":"7","feedbackIfSelected":"这是原输入序下M先的结果，但新规短任务在前已改变前驱完成。"},{"id":"B","text":"8","feedbackIfSelected":"正确：N(1)先至4，M(5)至9？稍算：N开始2完成3，M开始3完成8，O开始8。"},{"id":"C","text":"5","feedbackIfSelected":"误以为O到达即可开始，忽略M、N仍占服务器。"}],"correctOptionId":"B","debrief":"同时到达改按短优先后，N先完成于3，M完成于8，O开始于8。"}}}},{"slotId":"L3","explanation":"FIFO模型的一个关键边界是“同时到达按输入序”。若去掉该条件而采用其他排序，则不再是单服务器FIFO假设下所定义的调度。明确该边界可避免把任意排队规则都当作FIFO。","sourceRefs":[],"visualRefs":[],"semanticRelations":[],"workedProcess":null,"contrast":{"text":"若放弃“同时到达按输入序”而改用最短服务优先，则更短任务可能排在更早到达者之前，这违背了FIFO不重排的假设；资料中的案例里C虽短仍落后于B正是该边界生效的结果。","sourceRefs":[],"visualRefs":[]}}]

concepts.name: 队列的FIFO特性与基本操作
concepts.summary: 队列以先进先出顺序存储项目。Enqueue在队尾添加，dequeue移除并返回队首，peek返回队首不移除。队列内容用方括号从首到尾表示，如[A,B,C]下次dequeue返回A。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_0_61a5b659","quote":"A queue stores items in first-in, first-out order, abbreviated FIFO.","startOffset":0,"endOffset":68,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: 操作返回值与剩余队列状态区分
concepts.summary: 对队列执行dequeue等操作时，操作返回的值与操作后队列中剩余的元素是不同的概念，分别回答不同问题，不应混淆。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_1_a6cd292c","quote":"Distinguish an operation's returned value from the collection remaining afterward; they answer different questions.","startOffset":248,"endOffset":363,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: 空队列操作的安全约定
concepts.summary: 在空队列上执行dequeue或peek时，操作报告empty且队列保持不变，不虚构项目或复用已移除项目，保证状态明确。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_2_c346a5a5","quote":"If dequeue or peek is requested on an empty queue, the operation reports empty and leaves the queue unchanged.","startOffset":109,"endOffset":219,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: 单服务器FIFO等待队列调度模型
concepts.summary: 用FIFO等待队列组织单服务器：一次服务一个任务，运行至完成不中断，服务器空闲且有任务时立即开始；到达加队尾，服务中任务不在等待队列；同时到达按输入顺序。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_3_90e3c538","quote":"A FIFO waiting queue can organize a single server.","startOffset":0,"endOffset":50,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: FIFO不基于任务长度重排
concepts.summary: FIFO严格按到达先后顺序服务，即使后续任务服务时间更短也不会提前。如例子中C比B短，但仍排在B之后服务。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_4_c8a0634f","quote":"C is shorter than B, but FIFO does not move it ahead of an earlier arrival.","startOffset":299,"endOffset":374,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

concepts.name: FIFO任务时间参数计算方法
concepts.summary: FIFO下任务开始时间为到达时间与上一任务完成时间的较大者，完成时间为开始加服务时长。等待时间为开始减到达，系统内总时间为完成减到达，需分别说明；服务器空闲时新任务在到达时开始。
concepts.grounding: {"blockId":"blk_5_3ea97e1d","quote":"Waiting time is start minus arrival, whereas total time in the system is finish minus arrival.","startOffset":264,"endOffset":358,"occurrenceCount":1,"reanchored":false}

material_revisions.content:
A queue stores items in first-in, first-out order, abbreviated FIFO. Enqueue adds an item at the back. Dequeue removes and returns the item at the front. Peek returns the front item without removing it. We write queue contents from front to back in square brackets. The queue [A, B, C] will return A on the next dequeue, not C. The order of insertion determines this behavior, not alphabetical order.

Start with an empty queue. Enqueue A, enqueue B, and enqueue C produce [A, B, C]. A dequeue returns A and leaves [B, C]. Enqueue D then gives [B, C, D]. Peek returns B and leaves the same three items. A further dequeue returns B and leaves [C, D]. Distinguish an operation's returned value from the collection remaining afterward; they answer different questions.

In this lesson items have distinct identifiers and the queue has enough capacity for every stated operation. If dequeue or peek is requested on an empty queue, the operation reports empty and leaves the queue unchanged. It does not invent an item or silently reuse the most recently removed one. All worked sequences specify the initial queue and every operation, so there is no hidden earlier state.

A FIFO waiting queue can organize a single server. Assume one task is served at a time, tasks run to completion without interruption, and service begins immediately whenever the server is free and a task is waiting. Arrivals join the back of the waiting queue. A task currently being served is no longer in the waiting queue. When several arrivals share a time, use their stated input order. Durations and arrival times use the same time unit.

For example A arrives at time 0 and needs 4 units of service. B arrives at time 1 and needs 2; C arrives at time 2 and needs 1. A starts at 0 and finishes at 4. B waits from 1 to 4, starts at 4, and finishes at 6. C starts at 6 and finishes at 7. Their waiting times before service are 0, 3, and 4. C is shorter than B, but FIFO does not move it ahead of an earlier arrival. At time 3, A is in service and the waiting queue is [B, C].

For tasks in FIFO order, start time is the larger of arrival time and the previous task's finish time; finish time equals start plus service duration. This also handles idle time: a new task arriving at 10 after the server became free at 7 starts at 10, not at 7. Waiting time is start minus arrival, whereas total time in the system is finish minus arrival. State these quantities separately. The lesson's conclusion is service order under a specified policy, not a claim that FIFO minimizes every possible performance measure.

rectOptionId":"A","correctDebrief":"前一任务链完成于8，O到达5不早于该时刻，故开始=8。","reasoningOperation":"predict_outcome","requiredInference":"由M完成6、N接续至8，推得O开始为8。","decisiveCondition":"O到达5且上一完成8，故开始=max(5,8)=8。","evidenceContrast":{"evidence":"M开始2完成6","replacement":"M开始2完成7","alternativeOptionId":"B"}},"hint":"先看M完成后谁在队列：N到达2且未服务，故N先。","scaffold":{"prompt":"N的开始时间是多少？","options":[{"id":"A","text":"6","feedbackIfSelected":"正确：N开始于M完成6。"},{"id":"B","text":"2","feedbackIfSelected":"误把到达时间当开始，忽略M占用服务器。"}],"correctOptionId":"A","debrief":"N虽与M同时到达，但输入序在后，须等M完成。","reasoningOperation":"predict_outcome","requiredInference":"由M完成6且N排队，推得N开始6。","decisiveCondition":"N到达2，上一完成6，开始=max(2,6)=6。"},"transfer":{"changedCondition":"同时到达任务按服务时长升序排列（最短优先），其余FIFO；案例改为M服务5、N服务1同时到达2输入序M然后N，O到达5服务1。","prompt":"在新规下，O的开始时间是多少？","options":[{"id":"A","text":"7","feedbackIfSelected":"这是原输入序下M先的结果，但新规短任务在前已改变前驱完成。"},{"id":"B","text":"8","feedbackIfSelected":"正确：N(1)先至4，M(5)至9？稍算：N开始2完成3，M开始3完成8，O开始8。"},{"id":"C","text":"5","feedbackIfSelected":"误以为O到达即可开始，忽略M、N仍占服务器。"}],"correctOptionId":"B","debrief":"同时到达改按短优先后，N先完成于3，M完成于8，O开始于8。","reasoningOperation":"predict_outcome","requiredInference":"应用新排序规则重算前驱完成时间，得O开始8。","evidenceContrast":{"evidence":"同时到达任务按服务时长升序排列（最短优先），其余FIFO；案例改为M服务5、N服务1同时到达2输入序M然后N，O到达5服务1。","replacement":"同时到达任务按输入序排列（原FIFO），案例同M服务5、N服务1同时到达2输入序M然后N，O到达5服务1。","alternativeOptionId":"A"}}}}},{"slotId":"L3","explanation":"FIFO模型的一个关键边界是“同时到达按输入序”。若去掉该条件而采用其他排序，则不再是本单元所定义的FIFO单服务器调度。明确该边界可避免把任意排队规则都当作FIFO。","sourceRefs":["S4","S5"],"visualRefs":[],"semanticRelations":[],"workedProcess":null,"contrast":{"text":"若放弃“同时到达按输入序”而改用最短服务优先，则更短任务可能排在更早到达者之前，这违背了本目标中FIFO不重排的假设；原S5案例C虽短仍落后于B正是该边界生效的结果。","sourceRefs":["S4","S5"],"visualRefs":[]}}]}}

source_blocks.content: A queue stores items in first-in, first-out order, abbreviated FIFO. Enqueue adds an item at the back. Dequeue removes and returns the item at the front. Peek returns the front item without removing it. We write queue contents from front to back in square brackets. The queue [A, B, C] will return A on the next dequeue, not C. The order of insertion determines this behavior, not alphabetical order.

Start with an empty queue. Enqueue A, enqueue B, and enqueue C produce [A, B, C]. A dequeue returns A and leaves [B, C]. Enqueue D then gives [B, C, D]. Peek returns B and leaves the same three items. A further dequeue returns B and leaves [C, D]. Distinguish an operation's returned value from the collection remaining afterward; they answer different questions.

In this lesson items have distinct identifiers and the queue has enough capacity for every stated operation. If dequeue or peek is requested on an empty queue, the operation reports empty and leaves the queue unchanged. It does not invent an item or silently reuse the most recently removed one. All worked sequences specify the initial queue and every operation, so there is no hidden earlier state.

A FIFO waiting queue can organize a single server. Assume one task is served at a time, tasks run to completion without interruption, and service begins immediately whenever the server is free and a task is waiting. Arrivals join the back of the waiting queue. A task currently being served is no longer in the waiting queue. When several arrivals share a time, use their stated input order. Durations and arrival times use the same time unit.

For example A arrives at time 0 and needs 4 units of service. B arrives at time 1 and needs 2; C arrives at time 2 and needs 1. A starts at 0 and finishes at 4. B waits from 1 to 4, starts at 4, and finishes at 6. C starts at 6 and finishes at 7. Their waiting times before service are 0, 3, and 4. C is shorter than B, but FIFO does not move it ahead of an earlier arrival. At time 3, A is in service and the waiting queue is [B, C].

For tasks in FIFO order, start time is the larger of arrival time and the previous task's finish time; finish time equals start plus service duration. This also handles idle time: a new task arriving at 10 after the server became free at 7 starts at 10, not at 7. Waiting time is start minus arrival, whereas total time in the system is finish minus arrival. State these quantities separately. The lesson's conclusion is service order under a specified policy, not a claim that FIFO minimizes every possible performance measure.
